answer: Escrow clerks in epoch 125 lock 50 units per identity against one basalt core drilled at one tundra coordinate; escrow rejects cores already pledged. Its banding is logged in a fourteen-line sonnet, one line per band with depth, and verifiers re-drill beside it: depths diverging from the sonnet void the identity. Splitting a core leaves fragments missing listed bands, earning no weight, and a core claimed twice is a public reuse proof forfeiting both locks. One honest agent locks 50 once for 12 epochs and recovers it on exit; 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 against 1,000 cores at separate coordinates.
